title: 前端性能优化完全手册
author: TechBlog
excerpt: 从加载性能到渲染优化，从资源压缩到缓存策略，打造极致的前端体验。
excerptEn: From loading performance to rendering optimization, from resource compression to caching strategies, create the ultimate frontend experience.
content:
前端性能是用户体验的核心要素之一。页面加载速度、交互响应时间、动画流畅度等性能指标直接影响用户的满意度和转化率。随着 Web 应用的复杂度不断增加，前端性能优化变得越来越重要。本文将从性能度量开始，全面介绍前端性能优化的各个层面，包括网络优化、渲染优化、构建优化和缓存策略等，帮助你构建极速的 Web 应用。

性能指标与度量

性能优化的第一步是建立科学的性能度量体系。没有度量就没有优化，我们需要明确知道当前的性能状态，才能针对性地进行改进。

核心性能指标

Core Web Vitals 是 Google 提出的用户体验度量标准，包括三个核心指标： Largest Contentful Paint（LCP）衡量加载性能，目标是 2.5 秒以内；First Input Delay（FID）/ Interaction to Next Paint（INP）衡量交互响应性，目标是 100 毫秒以内； Cumulative Layout Shift（CLS）衡量视觉稳定性，目标是 0.1 以内。

// 使用 Performance Observer 监控 Core Web Vitals
const observerConfig = {
  attributes: true,
  characterData: true,
  characterDataOldValue: true,
  childList: true,
  subtree: true
};

// 监控 LCP
const lcpObserver = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
  const entries = list.getEntries();
  const lastEntry = entries[entries.length - 1];
  console.log('LCP:', lastEntry.startTime);
  
  // 上报到分析系统
  reportMetrics({ 
    name: 'LCP', 
    value: lastEntry.startTime,
    rating: lastEntry.startTime > 2500 ? 'poor' : 'good'
  });
});

lcpObserver.observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });

// 监控 FID
const fidObserver = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
  list.getEntries().forEach((entry) => {
    if (entry.processingStart - entry.startTime > 100) {
      console.log('FID:', entry.processingStart - entry.startTime);
      reportMetrics({
        name: 'FID',
        value: entry.processingStart - entry.startTime
      });
    }
  });
});

fidObserver.observe({ type: 'first-input', buffered: true });

// 监控 CLS

      console.log('Current CLS:', clsValue);
    }

clsObserver.observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });

自定义性能监控

// 监控关键业务指标
class PerformanceMonitor {
  constructor() {
    this.metrics = {};
  }

  // 监控页面加载时间
  measurePageLoad() {
    const [navigation] = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation');
    
    this.metrics = {
      dns: navigation.domainLookupEnd - navigation.domainLookupStart,
      tcp: navigation.connectEnd - navigation.connectStart,
      ssl: navigation.secureConnectionStart > 0 
        ? navigation.connectEnd - navigation.secureConnectionStart 
        : 0,
      ttfb: navigation.responseStart - navigation.requestStart,
      download: navigation.responseEnd - navigation.responseStart,
      domParse: navigation.domInteractive - navigation.responseEnd,
      jsExecute: navigation.domContentLoadedEventEnd - navigation.domInteractive,
      render: navigation.loadEventStart - navigation.domContentLoadedEventEnd,
      total: navigation.loadEventStart - navigation.fetchStart
    };

    return this.metrics;
  }

  // 监控资源加载
  measureResources() {
    const resources = performance.getEntriesByType('resource');
    
    const categorized = {
      script: [],
      stylesheet: [],
      image: [],
      fetch: [],
      xhr: [],
      other: []
    };

    resources.forEach(resource => {
      const { name, duration, transferSize, initiatorType } = resource;
      const category = categorized[initiatorType] || categorized.other;
      category.push({ name, duration, transferSize });
    });

    return categorized;
  }

  // 监控长任务
  measureLongTasks() {
    const longTaskObserver = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
      list.getEntries().forEach(entry => {
        console.log('Long task detected:', entry.duration);
        if (entry.duration > 50) {
          reportMetrics({
            name: 'longTask',
            value: entry.duration,
            attribution: entry.attribution
          });
        }
      });
    });

    longTaskObserver.observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true });
  }

  // 手动标记性能点
  mark(name) {
    performance.mark(name);
  }

  measure(name, startMark, endMark) {
    performance.measure(name, startMark, endMark);
    const entries = performance.getEntriesByName(name);
    return entries[entries.length - 1];
  }
}

const monitor = new PerformanceMonitor();

// 在关键点标记

/*
Service Worker 缓存

// sw.js
const CACHE_NAME = 'v1';
const ASSETS_TO_CACHE = [
  '/',
  '/styles/main.css',
  '/scripts/app.js',
  '/images/logo.png'
];

// 安装阶段缓存资源
self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME)
      .then((cache) => cache.addAll(ASSETS_TO_CACHE))
      .then(() => self.skipWaiting())
  );
});

// 激活阶段清理旧缓存
self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((cacheNames) => {
      return Promise.all(
        cacheNames
          .filter((name) => name !== CACHE_NAME)
          .map((name) => caches.delete(name))
      );
    }).then(() => self.clients.claim())
  );
});

// 拦截请求，优先返回缓存
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  // 只处理 GET 请求
  if (event.request.method !== 'GET') return;

  event.respondWith(
    caches.match(event.request)
      .then((cachedResponse) => {
        if (cachedResponse) {
          // 返回缓存同时更新缓存（stale-while-revalidate）
          event.waitUntil(
            fetch(event.request).then((response) => {
              if (response.ok) {
                caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
                  cache.put(event.request, response.clone());
                });
              }
            })
          );
          return cachedResponse;
        }

        // 没有缓存，发起网络请求
        return fetch(event.request).then((response) => {
          if (response.ok) {
            const responseClone = response.clone();
            caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
              cache.put(event.request, responseClone);
            });
          }
          return response;
        });
      })
      .catch(() => {
        // 离线回退
        return caches.match('/offline.html');
      })
  );
});

/*
使用 requestAnimationFrame
*/

function animate(element, start, end, duration) {
  const startTime = performance.now();
  
  function update(currentTime) {
    const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
    const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
    
    // 使用 easeOutCubic 缓动函数
    const easeProgress = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
    const current = start + (end - start) * easeProgress;
    
    element.style.transform = `translateX(${current}px)`;
    
    if (progress < 1) {
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }
  }
  
  requestAnimationFrame(update);
}

防抖与节流

/*
防抖和节流是控制函数执行频率的常用技术
*/

// 防抖：延迟执行，在延迟时间内再次调用会重置延迟
function debounce(func, wait, immediate = false) {
  let timeout;
  
  return function executedFunction(...args) {
    const context = this;
    
    const later = () => {
      timeout = null;
      if (!immediate) func.apply(context, args);
    };
    
    const callNow = immediate && !timeout;
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
    
    if (callNow) func.apply(context, args);
  };
}

// 节流：固定间隔执行
function throttle(func, limit) {
  let inThrottle;
  
  return function executedFunction(...args) {
    const context = this;
    
    if (!inThrottle) {
      func.apply(context, args);
      inThrottle = true;
      setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
    }
  };
}

// 使用示例
const debouncedSearch = debounce((query) => {
  fetch(`/api/search?q=${query}`)
    .then(res => res.json())
    .then(data => updateResults(data));
}, 300);

const throttledScroll = throttle(() => {
  checkVisibility();
  updateProgress();
}, 100);

window.addEventListener('scroll', throttledScroll);
document.getElementById('search').addEventListener('input', debouncedSearch);

// React Hook 中的防抖
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

function useDebounce(value, delay) {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);
    
    return () => clearTimeout(handler);
  }, [value, delay]);
  
  return debouncedValue;
}

// 使用
function SearchComponent() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const debouncedQuery = useDebounce(query, 300);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (debouncedQuery) {
      fetchResults(debouncedQuery);
    }
  }, [debouncedQuery]);
  
  return  setQuery(e.target.value)} />;

缓存策略设计

合理的缓存策略可以大幅减少重复请求，提升用户体验。

多层缓存体系

/*
浏览器缓存策略
*/

// HTTP 缓存头
Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
ETag: "v1.2.3"
Last-Modified: Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:00 GMT

/*
Service Worker 缓存策略
*/

// sw.js - 多种缓存策略
const CACHE_VERSION = 'v2';

// 缓存优先策略 - 静态资源
const STATIC_CACHE = `static-${CACHE_VERSION}`;
const STATIC_ASSETS = [
  '/',
  '/index.html',
  '/styles/main.css',
  '/scripts/app.js'
];

// 网络优先策略 - API 数据
const DATA_CACHE = `data-${CACHE_VERSION}`;

// Stale-while-revalidate - 混合策略
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const { request } = event;
  const url = new URL(request.url);

  // 静态资源：缓存优先
  if (request.destination === 'style' || 
      request.destination === 'script' ||
      request.destination === 'image') {
    event.respondWith(
      caches.match(request).then(cached => {
        const fetchPromise = fetch(request).then(response => {
          if (response.ok) {
            const clone = response.clone();
            caches.open(STATIC_CACHE).then(cache => {
              cache.put(request, clone);
            });
          }
          return response;
        });
        return cached || fetchPromise;
      })
    );
    return;
  }

  // API 数据：网络优先
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(request)
        .then(response => {
          if (response.ok) {
            const clone = response.clone();
            caches.open(DATA_CACHE).then(cache => {
              cache.put(request, clone);
            });
          }
          return response;
        })
        .catch(() => {
          return caches.match(request);
        })
    );
    return;
  }

  // 页面导航：网络优先，回退到缓存
  if (request.mode === 'navigate') {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(request)
        .catch(() => caches.match('/index.html'))
    );
    return;
  }
});

性能监控与告警

持续的性能监控是保证应用性能的重要手段。应该在生产环境中建立完善的性能监控体系。

性能监控实现

/*
性能监控 SDK 简化实现
*/

class PerformanceMonitor {
  constructor(endpoint) {
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
    this.buffer = [];
    this.flushInterval = 5000;
    
    this.init();
  }

  init() {
    // 收集 Core Web Vitals
    this.collectCoreWebVitals();
    
    // 收集资源性能
    this.collectResourceTiming();
    
    // 错误监控
    this.collectErrors();
    
    // 定期上报
    setInterval(() => this.flush(), this.flushInterval);
    
    // 页面离开时上报
    window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
        this.flush();
      }
    });
  }

  collectCoreWebVitals() {
    const metrics = ['LCP', 'FID', 'CLS'];
    
    metrics.forEach(metric => {
      const observer = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
        const entries = list.getEntries();
        const latest = entries[entries.length - 1];
        
        this.buffer.push({
          type: 'web_vital',
          metric,
          value: latest.value,
          rating: this.getRating(metric, latest.value),
          timestamp: Date.now()
        });
      });
      
      observer.observe({ type: metric.toLowerCase(), buffered: true });
    });
  }

  collectResourceTiming() {
    const observer = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
      list.getEntries().forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.initiatorType !== 'navigation') {
          this.buffer.push({
            type: 'resource',
            name: entry.name,
            duration: entry.duration,
            size: entry.transferSize,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          });
        }
      });
    });
    
    observer.observe({ type: 'resource', buffered: true });
  }

  collectErrors() {
    window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
      this.buffer.push({
        type: 'error',
        message: event.message,
        filename: event.filename,
        lineno: event.lineno,
        colno: event.colno,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
    });

    window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
      this.buffer.push({
        type: 'error',
        message: `Unhandled Promise Rejection: ${event.reason}`,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
    });
  }

  getRating(metric, value) {
    const thresholds = {
      LCP: { good: 2500, poor: 4000 },
      FID: { good: 100, poor: 300 },
      CLS: { good: 0.1, poor: 0.25 }
    };
    
    const { good, poor } = thresholds[metric] || { good: Infinity, poor: Infinity };
    return value <= good ? 'good' : value <= poor ? 'needs-improvement' : 'poor';
  }

  async flush() {
    if (this.buffer.length === 0) return;
    
    const data = [...this.buffer];
    this.buffer = [];
    
    try {
      await fetch(this.endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ metrics: data }),
        keepalive: true
      });
    } catch (error) {
      // 上报失败，放回缓冲区
      this.buffer.unshift(...data);
    }
  }
}

告警配置

/*
告警规则示例（基于 Prometheus）
*/

groups:
- name: frontend-performance
  rules:
  
  # LCP 告警
  - alert: HighLCP
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum(rate(vital_lcp_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 4000
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: "Large Contentful Paint 过高"
      description: "p75 LCP 为 {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}，超过 4 秒"

  # CLS 告警
  - alert: HighCLS
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.75, sum(rate(vital_cls_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.25
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: "Cumulative Layout Shift 过高"
      description: "页面布局偏移严重，p75 CLS 为 {{ $value }}"

  # JS 错误率告警
  - alert: HighJSErrorRate
    expr: |
      sum(rate(js_errors_total[5m]))
      / sum(rate(js_pv_total[5m])) > 0.01
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: "JavaScript 错误率过高"
      description: "错误率为 {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}"

  # 页面加载时间告警
  - alert: SlowPageLoad
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(page_load_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 5
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: "页面加载时间过长"
      description: "p95 加载时间为 {{ $value }} 秒"

前端性能优化是一个持续的过程，不可能一蹴而就。通过建立完善的性能监控体系，识别性能瓶颈，然后针对性地进行优化。可以从用户最敏感的核心指标开始，逐步扩展到全链路的性能优化。记住，最好的优化往往不是技术上的花哨技巧，而是对用户体验的深入理解和持续关注。测量、分析、优化、再测量，形成闭环，才能真正实现持续的性能改进。
